abilities.name: leitvia/activate-token-set
abilities.label: Activate token set
abilities.description: Writes the presets of a token set into the global styles of the active theme. The set ID comes from leitvia/create-token-set or the sets of leitvia/get-tokens. The base hash is the hash of the global styles. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash.

items.description: For a list of items: the result per item in their order, or code, message, reason and target of its rejection.

abilities.name: leitvia/add-building-block
abilities.label: Add building block
abilities.description: Adds a building block of leitvia/list-building-blocks to the site: its content types, taxonomies, relations and site settings through leitvia/define-content-type, merged with the entries that exist so fields a person added stay; the default values of its site settings that are empty; and its sample entries with their terms as drafts. Design, header, footer, pages and front page stay as they are. What the autonomy does not let go live waits in one change package. With settle, a person (manage_options, not the agent role) in the admin, neither signed in with an application password nor calling over MCP, gets that package applied right away: applied lists it, partial names a package applied in part with its errors. Entries that exist are kept, so the block can be added again to fill in what is missing.

name.description: Name of the building block, for example my-addon/events.

samples.description: Whether to add the sample entries as drafts.

package.description: Key of the task: every part goes into the change package of that key, nothing goes live.

settle.description: Apply what collects at once instead of leaving it in the Inbox. Only for a person in the admin; agents, application passwords and MCP clients get the autonomy.

abilities.name: leitvia/add-media
abilities.label: Add media
abilities.description: Adds an image to the media library from a URL of this site or as Base64 data up to 5 MB, with alt text or marked as decorative. It also takes a WebVTT file with captions for a video (.vtt, UTF-8, starts with WEBVTT, no alt text). It needs the right to upload files. URLs of other hosts are rejected; nothing is fetched from them. base_hash is empty. Images already in the library are used by their ID in compose-page and update-block, a WebVTT file by its ID in tracks of update-block.

abilities.name: leitvia/apply-package
abilities.label: Apply change package
abilities.description: Applies the open operations of a change package, all or the listed ones. Find the package with leitvia/list-packages and check its diff with leitvia/get-package first. Each operation checks its base hash; one whose target changed stays open with a conflict, the others are written with snapshot and audit entry. Agents may only apply operations whose autonomy level is autonomous.

operations.description: Operation IDs to apply; empty or missing for every open operation.

abilities.name: leitvia/apply-recipe
abilities.label: Apply recipe
abilities.description: Sets up the site from a recipe of leitvia/list-recipes: content model and building blocks, token set, style variation, header and footer, pages from patterns, navigation, reading settings and options that save data. Each part runs through its own ability with the autonomy level of its area; what may not go live lands in one change package, and with a package key everything does. Settings that point to a page waiting in that package (front page, privacy policy page) are set when the package is applied. Pages that exist, and variation, header, footer and navigation changed since a recipe wrote them, are kept, as is the variation while a token set is active, so the recipe can run again after the package was applied. parts, pages and buildingBlocks limit the run to a selection, and slugs gives recipe pages other addresses; navigation and footer then link only the pages that are on the site or come in this run, and a navigation without any of them waits. dryRun reports what would change without writing. Review the package with leitvia/get-package. With settle, a person (manage_options, not the agent role) in the admin, neither signed in with an application password nor calling over MCP, who runs it without a package key applies what collects at once: applied lists the packages applied in full, which can be rolled back in the Inbox, and partial the packages applied in part, with their errors. Without settle the package waits.

recipe.description: Name from leitvia/list-recipes, for example leitvia/blog.

package.description: Key of the task: every part goes into the change package of that key, nothing goes live.

parts.description: Parts to apply, all by default: buildingBlocks (content model and building blocks), samples (their sample entries), design (token set and style variation), header, footer, pages, navigation, frontPage (reading settings) and options (page settings and data-saving options).

pages.description: Slugs of the recipe pages to create, all by default.

slugs.description: Other slugs for recipe pages, by the slug of the recipe, such as {"imprint": "impressum"}. Links, navigation and settings follow. Send the same slugs on a later run; pages without a kind are found by their slug.

buildingBlocks.description: Names of the building blocks of the recipe to add, all by default. With a list only these blocks add content types, not the whole content model of the recipe.

dryRun.description: Report what each step would do (new, replace, exists, package, waiting) and the parts it replaces, without writing anything.

settle.description: Apply what collects at once instead of leaving it in the Inbox. Only for a person in the admin; agents, application passwords and MCP clients get the autonomy.

abilities.name: leitvia/audit-site
abilities.label: Audit site
abilities.description: Runs the content checks (headings, alt text, link text, #anchor links, block validity, unregistered blocks, tokens, contrast, one h1 and landmarks) over published content, at most 20 posts per call in ID order. Also reports classic content without blocks, deprecated patterns, preset slugs missing from the active tokens, internal links that lead to no page or to the old address of a renamed post, links that lead nowhere (empty href, # without target) on the rendered page outside content and template parts, with their class, pages that look like legal texts without a page kind, and placeholders left on legal pages: square brackets such as [Organization name] and sentences that say they are a placeholder. The first page (after 0) also returns site: an error when the site is closed to search engines outside a local or staging site, an error per header or footer part with such links, warnings for a missing imprint, contact or editorial page while there are posts, and for the latest 20 news posts without a featured image of at least 1200 px width or whose author has no biography. Pass next as after for the following page; next is null at the end.

after.description: Start after this post ID, the next value of the previous call.

abilities.name: leitvia/check-composition
abilities.label: Check composition
abilities.description: Scores a page against the composition rules of the contract: pass pattern slugs in page order (block:<ID> for a Lab pattern; only approved ones count as known), or a post ID to read the sections of a saved page from metadata.patternName. Returns the findings (rule and 0-based section index), the score from 100 down, the minimum score for autonomous writes and per finding up to three patterns that would fix it. For a post also unregistered: block types that render nothing.

template.description: Template slug, for example page-landing; for a post its saved template is used.

abilities.name: leitvia/compose-page
abilities.label: Compose page
abilities.description: Creates a page from patterns in the order of a page frame of the contract. Plan it with leitvia/plan-page first; base_hash is empty for the new page. Per section texts (also quote citations and details summaries), links and images at block IDs of the pattern outline can change, and remove and repeat take blocks from a parent or add copies, for fewer or more entries than the pattern; a text that would drop a link is refused. Edits apply in order. Each section keeps metadata.patternName (core/block/<ID> for a Lab pattern). Unknown patterns are rejected with a pointer to leitvia/list-patterns, deprecated ones with their replacement, Lab patterns that are not approved (also through a part) with leitvia_pattern_not_approved. Later changes go through leitvia/update-content and leitvia/update-block.

frame.description: Type of a page frame from pageFrames in the contract, for example home or service.

pattern.description: Pattern slug such as leitvia/hero-split-image, or block:<ID> for a Lab pattern.

block.description: Block ID or path ID from the outline.

text.description: Plain text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote or the summary of a details block.

link_text.description: Part of text that stays linked when the text holds a link, such as the mail address in a contact line. Without it the link stays around its old text, and a text without that is refused unless the link only points to #.

url.description: Link of a button, or of the one link in a paragraph, heading or list item (mailto: and tel: work too).

add_link.description: New link around a passage of a paragraph, heading, list item, citation or summary, as text with the exact words and url. Other links and inline formatting stay; the first place outside a link counts.

caption.description: Caption of an image, video, audio, gallery, table or embed as plain text; empty removes it.

remove.description: Removes the block from its parent, for a section with fewer entries than the pattern. Later edits of the list count from the result, so work from the last block to the first.

repeat.description: Number of copies to add right after the block, for a section with more entries than the pattern. Later edits reach the copies by the IDs they get.

template.description: Page template of the contract instead of the one of the frame, for example page-docs.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

items.description: For a list of items: the result per item in their order, or code, message, reason and target of its rejection.

abilities.name: leitvia/create-content
abilities.label: Create content
abilities.description: Creates a post, a page or an entry of the content model from block markup or patterns; base_hash is empty. Post types come from leitvia/get-content-model, sections work as in leitvia/compose-page. The content runs through the same checks as leitvia/update-content. Terms take IDs, names or slugs; a name no term has yet creates the term with the content, in categories at the top level and only for a user who may manage them, and in a change package it stays a name until the package is applied. Fields follow the content model; required fields must be set before publishing. The featured image needs alt text (leitvia/set-alt-text) or the decorative mark, or names the file of an image that waits in the same package from leitvia/add-media. The status is capped by the autonomy level. ai_generated adds a visible note to the text.

post_type.description: post, page or a post type of the content model.

content.description: Block markup; not together with sections.

pattern.description: Pattern slug such as leitvia/hero-split-image, or block:<ID> for a Lab pattern.

block.description: Block ID or path ID from the outline.

text.description: Plain text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote or the summary of a details block.

link_text.description: Part of text that stays linked when the text holds a link, such as the mail address in a contact line. Without it the link stays around its old text, and a text without that is refused unless the link only points to #.

url.description: Link of a button, or of the one link in a paragraph, heading or list item (mailto: and tel: work too).

add_link.description: New link around a passage of a paragraph, heading, list item, citation or summary, as text with the exact words and url. Other links and inline formatting stay; the first place outside a link counts.

caption.description: Caption of an image, video, audio, gallery, table or embed as plain text; empty removes it.

remove.description: Removes the block from its parent, for a section with fewer entries than the pattern. Later edits of the list count from the result, so work from the last block to the first.

repeat.description: Number of copies to add right after the block, for a section with more entries than the pattern. Later edits reach the copies by the IDs they get.

parent.description: ID of the parent entry of the same hierarchical post type.

date.description: Date in the time zone of the site, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

template.description: Template of the contract: page templates such as page-docs for pages, single templates for the other types.

author.description: User ID of the author, as author in leitvia/list-content shows it; the user must be able to edit this post type. Without it a new post belongs to the user who writes it. An author without a display name of their own shows as the name of the site, never as the login.

terms.description: Terms by taxonomy, such as {"category": ["News"], "post_tag": ["events", 12]}: IDs as numbers, names or slugs as text. They replace the terms of that taxonomy.

fields.description: Values of the fields and relations of the content model by meta key; null empties a field.

id.description: Attachment ID of an image, 0 to remove the featured image.

decorative.description: Whether the image only decorates, so it needs no alt text.

file.description: File name of an image that waits in the same package from leitvia/add-media, instead of id; it is resolved when the package is applied.

comment_status.description: Whether visitors may comment; without it a new post takes the default of the site.

ai_generated.description: Whether AI wrote the text; it then shows a note that says so.

sources.description: URLs of the sources of the text, stored with it.

seo.description: SEO title and meta description, checked and written as by leitvia/update-seo. With an unsupported SEO plugin they are left out and notice says so.

abilities.label: Create pattern
abilities.description: Creates a pattern in the Lab as a draft with version 0.1.0 from block markup; base_hash is empty. Blocks and their attributes come from leitvia/list-blocks. The checks run on its markup, design tokens included. To build on an existing pattern use leitvia/vary-pattern.

abilities.name: leitvia/create-product
abilities.label: Create product
abilities.description: Creates a simple product. It takes title, slug, texts as block markup or plain text (a long description in plain text becomes paragraph blocks, one per block of text between blank lines), prices, SKU, stock, categories and an image of the media library; base_hash is empty. Categories take IDs, slugs or names; a name no category has yet creates that category. The image needs alt text (leitvia/set-alt-text). The status is capped by the autonomy level, and a product with a price lands at most as a suggestion unless a person unlocked prices.

description.description: Long description, block markup or plain text. Plain text without HTML becomes paragraph blocks: a blank line starts a new paragraph, the text is escaped. No fixed length, as with the content of leitvia/update-content; a change package shows the comparison up to 1 MB for before and after together.

short_description.description: Short description next to the price, block markup or plain text.

regular_price.description: Price as a decimal number with a dot, empty for none. A price change lands at most as a suggestion.

sale_price.description: Price as a decimal number with a dot, empty for none. A price change lands at most as a suggestion.

stock.description: Units in stock; turns on stock management for the product. Without it the product is in stock without a count.

categories.description: Product categories as IDs (numbers), slugs or names (text). A name no category has yet creates the category.

image.description: Attachment ID of an image with alt text.

abilities.name: leitvia/create-token-set
abilities.label: Create token set
abilities.description: Creates a token set from a DTCG document. Start from the document leitvia/get-tokens returns; base_hash is empty for the new set. It must compile against the contract and pass every token set check; contrast findings name the failing pair and the ratio it needs. Optional group size: page widths. Activate it with leitvia/activate-token-set.

document.description: DTCG token document, as leitvia/get-tokens returns it.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

abilities.name: leitvia/crop-media
abilities.label: Crop media
abilities.description: Crops an image of the media library into a new image. The rectangle is in percent of the image size; the original stays. The new image takes the alt text of the original and its title with an addition. Use it for images with text burned in: keep the part without the text band. Only JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP and AVIF, no SVG; it needs the right to upload files. base_hash is empty. A live crop gets a change package, so leitvia/rollback deletes the new image with its files.

id.description: ID of the image in the media library, from leitvia/list-media.

x.description: Left edge of the rectangle in percent of the image width.

y.description: Top edge of the rectangle in percent of the image height.

width.description: Width of the rectangle in percent of the image width, above 0; x plus width is at most 100.

height.description: Height of the rectangle in percent of the image height, above 0; y plus height is at most 100.

title_suffix.description: Addition to the title of the original, in brackets after it; without it the addition is cropped.

abilities.name: leitvia/define-content-type
abilities.label: Define content type
abilities.description: Adds entries to the content model (postTypes, taxonomies, relations, settings) and keeps the others. An entry that exists is merged: the input sets its own keys and fields, fields, repeaters and supports it does not name stay, and the postTypes of a taxonomy are joined; relations and settings are replaced whole. Nothing is removed through this ability: an entry, field, repeater or supports value can only be removed by a person on the Model screen. Read the declaration with leitvia/get-content-model first. The base hash is the hash of the content model. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash. showInAbilities stays a decision of a person: agents may not set it.

declaration.description: Content model declaration with the entries to add or replace, see leitvia/get-content-model.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

abilities.name: leitvia/export
abilities.label: Export site
abilities.description: Exports the site as a portable JSON package, page by page. Pages (block markup), navigation menus and token sets (DTCG document) come in items; the first call (offset 0) also carries the template parts of the active theme and the content model. Each item carries its hash. Items of one call stay under 1048576 bytes; call again with offset set to next until next is null. Choose parts to export less. Writes nothing; drafts are included, private and password protected content is not.

parts.description: Parts to export; all when empty.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-block
abilities.label: Get block
abilities.description: Returns one block of a post by its ID or path ID with all attributes, its markup alone and with children, the image attachments, its hash, the IDs of its children and the document hash. Classic content without blocks is one block p:0 named core/freeform.

block.description: Block ID from the page outline.

markup.description: The block with its children as block markup: change it and send it as content of leitvia/update-template-part, or with the other top-level blocks of a post as content of leitvia/update-content.

attachments.description: Images in inner_html that are attachments of this site, in order: attachment ID and the src as written.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-content-model
abilities.label: Get content model
abilities.description: Returns the content model declaration: post types, taxonomies, fields, relations and site settings with their definitions, never content. valid is false when the declaration fails the schema and nothing of it is registered.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-contract
abilities.label: Get contract
abilities.description: Returns the site this connection works on (address, REST base, name, language, whether it is part of a multisite network) and the design contract of the active theme: version, rules, color roles, contrast pairs, composition rules, page frames, template parts, templates, block styles and style variations. Compare site.url with the address of your task before the first write. Patterns come from list-patterns, blocks from list-blocks.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-package
abilities.label: Get change package
abilities.description: Returns a change package with its operations: status, the post each applied operation wrote, conflicts and, for open operations, a block diff against the current state (per block added, removed, moved or changed with text before and after and the changed attributes). applied.post is the ID a new post got, applied.hash its hash after the write.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-page-outline
abilities.label: Get page outline
abilities.description: Returns a post as a compact block tree: per block the ID, name, pattern, the first 80 characters of text (with text_hash of the whole text when it is longer), the link targets of the block itself (links, only when it has any), for image and cover blocks the image with attachment ID, alt text and decorative mark, size, hash and children. shortcodes: unhandled shortcodes per block. Blocks without a stable ID have a path ID such as p:0.2.1 until the next save. Use the document hash as base_hash for changes and get-block for full attributes.

text_hash.description: Only when text was cut: the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the whole text, tags stripped, entities decoded, white space collapsed to single spaces and trimmed.

image.description: Image of an image or cover block: attachment ID (0 outside the media library), alt text (null without alt attribute) and the decorative mark.

shortcodes.description: Only when present: name and block of each.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-pattern
abilities.label: Get pattern
abilities.description: Returns one pattern of the theme or of Leitvia Studio with its markup, metadata and the first 20 posts and templates that use it (more is true when there are further ones). Template patterns come with their templateTypes.

slug.description: Pattern slug from list-patterns, for example leitvia/hero-split-image, or block:<ID> for a Lab pattern.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-product
abilities.label: Get product
abilities.description: Returns one product or variation: texts, images with alt text, categories and tags with their hash, attributes, price (read only), tax and shipping class, stock status, merchandising and the hash to use as base_hash. No sales, order or customer figures.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-seo
abilities.label: Get SEO data
abilities.description: Returns the SEO data of posts, pages and entries from the active SEO plugin. Supported are Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress and The SEO Framework. Per item: title, meta description, canonical, noindex, nofollow, Open Graph title, description and image, focus keyword and schema type. schema_type is the article type Leitvia Studio prints for a post (NewsArticle or BlogPosting), null where it prints none. indexable says whether the site is open to search engines, news_sitemap is the address of the news sitemap of Leitvia Studio or null, organization holds the address, phone and email of leitvia/set-organization. An empty value means the plugin falls back to its template. defaults holds what WordPress itself would print and a description suggested from the excerpt; without an SEO plugin plugin names Leitvia Studio, with an unsupported one seo is null, and notice says why. hash is the base_hash of leitvia/update-seo. IDs that are no readable content come back under skipped.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-site-health
abilities.label: Get site health
abilities.description: Returns the versions of WordPress, PHP, the theme and the plugins and the updates WordPress knows of, read from its last update check; nothing is requested. Needs a user who may view the Site Health checks, usually an administrator, or the agent role.

abilities.name: leitvia/get-tokens
abilities.label: Get tokens
abilities.description: Returns the active design tokens as a DTCG document (of the active token set, else of the current global styles), the token sets with their status, the active style variations, whether the global styles drifted from the active set and the contrast findings of the current palette.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-blocks
abilities.label: List blocks
abilities.description: Returns the block catalog of Leitvia Studio and its add-ons with attribute schema and usage rules. With post_type only the blocks the editor allows for that post type.

post_type.description: Limit to the blocks allowed for this post type.

description.description: Translated description of what the block does.

parent.description: Blocks this block must be a direct child of, null for anywhere.

ancestor.description: Blocks this block must be inside at any depth, null for anywhere.

supports.description: Supports of block.json an agent may use: align, anchor, color, spacing, typography, dimensions, border, shadow, layout, html, multiple, reusable, inserter, interactivity. Their attributes (className, style, backgroundColor and so on) are not listed under attributes.

attributes.description: JSON schema of the block attributes from block.json. A property with source is stored in the block markup, not in the block comment; rich-text is a string of HTML. leitviaAnimation (none, fade, rise, stagger, zoom, slide-start, slide-end, wipe-up, wipe-start, blur, mask, parallax) and leitviaMotion (subtle, bold) are on every block, core blocks included, except blocks without markup of their own, the navigation and leitvia/reveal; their descriptions say when they fit.

innerBlocks.description: Blocks allowed directly inside: allowedBlocks of block.json, otherwise the catalog blocks that name this block as parent. null when block.json sets no limit.

example.description: Saved markup of a block that keeps its content in HTML: write the block like this, an empty or self-closing block renders nothing. Blocks that render on the server have none; their attributes are enough.

usage.description: When to use the block. Required for Studio blocks, optional for add-on blocks.

owner.description: Slug of the add-on that registered the block in the Studio blocks registry, core for core blocks.

extension.description: Core blocks only: what Studio changes about the block.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-building-blocks
abilities.label: List building blocks
abilities.description: Lists the building blocks of add-ons: name, title, description, whether the site has them, their post types and taxonomies, the patterns that show them and the number of sample entries. Add one with leitvia/add-building-block.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-content
abilities.label: List content
abilities.description: Lists posts, pages and entries of the content model, newest first, with hash, terms and the open package that waits for each. Per item: ID, type, status, title, slug, date, modified, author (ID) and author_name as visitors see it, excerpt, terms, fields, link, hash and package. Filter by type, status, search text, modified since and published after a date. Only content agents may read; no comments, users or form entries.

since.description: Date in the time zone of the site, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

after.description: Date in the time zone of the site, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

Filter by IDs (include, in their order, for example the images of a gallery), by search text in title, caption and file name, MIME type (image, image/png or application/pdf) and uploaded after a date.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-patterns
abilities.label: List patterns
abilities.description: Lists the patterns of the theme, of Leitvia Studio and of its add-ons (source addon) with composition metadata, image slots, when to use and avoid them, lab status and the replacement of deprecated ones, followed by the Lab patterns (slug block:<ID>, source lab) with their lab status, version and document hash, and the composition of the theme pattern they vary. Only approved Lab patterns count as known in check-composition. Filter by role, tone, layout or category; at most 50 per page. Markup and usage come from get-pattern.

role.description: Filter by this value of the composition metadata.

tone.description: Filter by this value of the composition metadata.

layout.description: Filter by this value of the composition metadata.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-product-attributes

abilities.name: leitvia/list-product-reviews
abilities.label: List product reviews
abilities.description: Lists product reviews with rating and hash, 20 per page, oldest first; per review ID, product, author name, date, text, rating (1 to 5, 0 for none), verified owner and status. unrated lists only reviews without a rating; unrated_total counts them. Without the capability of the reviews screen of WooCommerce (moderate_comments) only approved reviews of published products, which visitors see anyway; status in the output names the status listed. No email address, IP address or user account of a reviewer.

abilities.name: leitvia/list-products
abilities.label: List products

abilities.name: leitvia/list-recipes
abilities.label: List recipes

abilities.name: leitvia/plan-page
abilities.label: Plan page
abilities.description: Proposes a page for a goal and content points: page frame, template, the patterns in page order with role, slot, text lengths and the points each section carries, and the composition score. Without AI the plan follows the page frames, examples and composition rules of the contract and is the same for the same input; it leaves out patterns that need images while the media library has none, post teasers below three published posts and proof or offer patterns, which carry facts of the person, and patterns the inserter hides, and plans a shop home from the home page of the shop recipe. A point that starts with the role, slot or area of a section and a colon (Hero: ...) lands on that section. With ai set to true the AI connector the site owner set up in WordPress refines it; the goal, the points and pattern names with their metadata are sent to that provider. Writes nothing; build the page with leitvia/compose-page.

frame.description: Type of a page frame; without it the frame named in the goal, else home.

ai.description: Refine the plan through the AI connector of the site. Sends the goal, the points and pattern names to that provider.

Use it for your own package when a run took a wrong turn; users with manage_options may discard any package. The package stays with the state rejected and the audit log keeps the call. abilities.name: leitvia/update-block
abilities.label: Update block
abilities.description: Changes one block found by its ID or path ID: attributes from the block catalog and the level of a heading, the text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote, the summary of a details block, the link of a button or of the one link in a text (link_text names the linked part), or the image of an image or cover block with alt text. add_link sets a new link on a passage of a text, caption the caption of an image, video, audio, gallery, table or embed. Attributes that a static block keeps in its markup, such as prefix, value, suffix and label of a counter, change like any other. query of a core/query merges into its settings. tracks of a core/video replaces its text tracks: each names a WebVTT file from leitvia/add-media by id, with kind, srclang and label. A spotlight point moves with attributes x and y in percent. The effect on scroll (leitviaAnimation, leitviaMotion) changes on every block that has it, core blocks and saved markup included, since only the block comment changes. Static markup is rebuilt with the HTML API; changes it cannot rebuild safely are rejected with leitvia_static_markup. Read the post with leitvia/get-page-outline first and send its hash as base_hash; get-block shows the current attributes. For several text changes in one post use leitvia/update-content.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-content
abilities.label: Update content
abilities.description: Updates title, excerpt, slug, date, status, author, terms, fields, featured image, comment status and the texts and button links of several blocks of one post in one operation, blocks found by their ID from the outline. Per block, url changes the one link of a text too, link_text names the part that stays linked, add_link sets a new link on a passage and caption the caption of a figure, as in leitvia/update-block. status publishes a draft, schedules it (future, with a date) or takes a post back to draft or pending; like every change it follows the autonomy level, so at a lower level it waits in a change package, and publishing needs the right to publish when it is applied. Terms, fields, featured image and template follow the rules of leitvia/create-content; terms replace those of their taxonomy, and template switches the post to another template of the contract (page-landing for a page). Instead of blocks, content replaces the whole content with block markup, for example to turn classic content into blocks; the new content may hold no classic block. Read the post with leitvia/get-page-outline first and send its hash as base_hash. A slug change is a URL change and lands at most as a suggestion; after one, leitvia/repair-links with auto points the links of other posts to the new address. For attributes or images of a block use leitvia/update-block.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-template
abilities.label: Update template
abilities.description: Replaces a template with a template pattern made for it or with changed block markup. Slugs, such as single, single-product or taxonomy-product_cat, come from the templates of leitvia/get-contract and the templates the theme ships; WooCommerce templates need WooCommerce. A pattern fits when its templateTypes hold the slug; the rejection leitvia_unknown_pattern lists the patterns that fit in patterns. Templates for single posts and pages keep a core/post-content block. The change publishes the template; where the area level is draft a new one waits in a change package. A rollback restores the template as it was, the one of the theme when there was no saved one. The base hash is the hash of the saved template, empty when the theme template has not been saved yet. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash.

base_hash.description: Hash of the target as last read; empty for a new object.

package.description: Key of the task: a write with a key always goes into the change package of that key, even where the autonomy would allow it live, and operations with the same key share that package.

slug_changed.description: The slug asked for (requested) is taken or reserved, so the address uses slug instead, on publishing at the latest.

applied.description: For a list of items: the package that holds what went live, for leitvia/rollback; 0 for none.

items.description: For a list of items: the result per item in their order, or code, message, reason and target of its rejection.

abilities.name: leitvia/update-template-part
abilities.label: Update template part
abilities.description: Replaces a template part of the contract, such as header, footer or sidebar, with a pattern made for its area or with changed block markup. Part names come from leitvia/get-contract; with Polylang <part>-<language> (header-de) is the part the theme shows for that language and is created in the area of its part. Patterns come from leitvia/list-patterns. The change publishes the part, a draft one too: core shows no draft part, so where the area level is draft it waits in a change package. The base hash is the hash of the template part. No ability returns this hash: send base_hash empty and repeat the call once with current_hash from leitvia_stale_hash.

abilities.name: leitvia/vary-pattern
abilities.label: Vary pattern
abilities.description: Creates a variant of a Lab pattern (block:<ID>) or a theme pattern (slug) as a draft in the Lab, from new markup or from the original with edits at block IDs; base_hash is empty. Originals come from leitvia/list-patterns, block IDs for edits from leitvia/get-pattern.

block.description: Block ID or path ID from the outline.

text.description: Plain text of a paragraph, heading, list item or button, the citation of a quote or the summary of a details block.

link_text.description: Part of text that stays linked when the text holds a link, such as the mail address in a contact line. Without it the link stays around its old text, and a text without that is refused unless the link only points to #.

url.description: Link of a button, or of the one link in a paragraph, heading or list item (mailto: and tel: work too).

add_link.description: New link around a passage of a paragraph, heading, list item, citation or summary, as text with the exact words and url. Other links and inline formatting stay; the first place outside a link counts.

caption.description: Caption of an image, video, audio, gallery, table or embed as plain text; empty removes it.

remove.description: Removes the block from its parent, for a section with fewer entries than the pattern. Later edits of the list count from the result, so work from the last block to the first.

repeat.description: Number of copies to add right after the block, for a section with more entries than the pattern. Later edits reach the copies by the IDs they get.
